items.q: Can we sell prescription-only skincare products online?
items.a: Yes — Rx products are gated behind provider verification and an active patient record. The catalog splits into OTC (open checkout) and Rx (requires provider approval + patient ID match). We wire the flow to your EHR or a lightweight patient portal, so scripts never ship to unauthorized buyers.

items.q: Which e-commerce platform do you build on — Shopify, custom, or something else?
items.a: We pick per client: Shopify Plus for medical spas doing $250k+ in product revenue, headless Shopify + custom storefront for practices needing patient portals and Rx gating, or fully custom for enterprise DSOs with EHR integration needs. Recommendation happens in week 1 after auditing your product mix, volume, and integration surface.

items.q: How do you handle HIPAA when patient data touches the storefront?
items.a: Patient identifiers stay out of the storefront database. Rx orders reference an anonymized patient ID resolved server-side against your EHR under a signed BAA. Analytics, marketing pixels, and third-party scripts are audited and stripped from any Rx-touching route.

items.q: Do you set up subscriptions for post-procedure kits and refills?
items.a: Yes — cleanser + SPF + retinoid kits, post-Mohs recovery bundles, and 30/60/90-day refill subscriptions with skip/pause/swap. Subscribers get 15% off by default, and providers can pre-authorize kits directly from the EHR so patients see them at checkout automatically.

items.q: How does the storefront affect our medical SEO?
items.a: Product pages target commercial-intent keywords ("buy Vitamin C serum", "tretinoin refill") that your service pages don't. Category → Product → Reviews structure earns Product schema, aggregate ratings, and Google Merchant Center listings. It expands your keyword footprint without cannibalizing your medical service pages.

items.q: How long does a dermatology e-commerce launch take?
items.a: OTC-only Shopify build: 5–7 weeks. Rx-gated with EHR integration: 8–12 weeks. Custom headless with subscriptions + provider portal: 12–16 weeks. Fixed launch date at kickoff with weekly milestone reviews.
